claims.text: Most service businesses miss the one-hour lead response window
Shops that reply within 5 minutes convert close to twice as often as those that don't
Owners commonly respond to lead slippage by hiring staff instead of fixing response speed
Automated text-back can answer missed calls instantly, including nights and weekends
